text: The town gathers

Sonnet and Sol were the killers. On Day 1 the town voted between Haiku and Sol, then turned on Sol in a runoff, and Sol confessed. On Day 2 Terra claimed officer and named Sonnet a killer, and Sonnet counter-claimed the same role and named Terra. Haiku pressed both for reasons, but Sonnet never gave a real one, so the table backed Terra and voted Sonnet out, which ended the game with the town winning.
